desc: In profile and general dimensions, these two Henry offerings are essentially the same as their blued steel counterparts, with 20 round barrel and 5-shot magazine capacity in the .30-30 and 18.43 round barrel with 4-shot magazine in the .45-70, and both with the same adjustable buckhorn/bead sights. Like the blued rifles, the All-Weathers also wear the same wrist profiles- straight in the .30-30, and pistolgrip in the .45-70. The major differences lie in the first time we've used hard chrome plating on all metal surfaces (except springs and sights), and a durable industrial-grade coating on hardwood furniture.
